dataset.name: Inventory Tracking v2 — Providers clinical supply demo data
dataset.description: Fictitious clinical supply inventory (Providers industry) keyed to the target inv2_ schema; item->category resolved via relationship. No source rows.

scenarios.title: Load clinical supplies
scenarios.narrative: Categories load first, then items resolve their category by name to the inv2_CategoryId lookup. Several items are at or below their reorder threshold.
